Activists Denied Bail in Delhi Riots Conspiracy Case

Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam, two activists accused of conspiring in the 2020 Delhi riots, have been denied bail by a court. The case has sparked controversy over allegations of conspiracy and involvement in the violence that left dozens dead and thousands injured. The court's decision has been met with criticism from some quarters, who argue that the charges are politically motivated.
